meta.note: Airdrop signals checked by hand on 2026-11-23 against the sources named in each entry. A protocol joins the dashboard's watchlist on a signal only when the hint is public and the source is named; unsourced hunches are excluded. Signals describe what a team said or runs, never a promise that a token will reach any reader.

polymarket-international.note: CMO Matthew Modabber said on the Degenz Live podcast: “there will be a token, there will be an airdrop”, timed after the US relaunch. No date, ticker or eligibility rules have been published.
polymarket-international.ref: Degenz Live podcast, broadcast on X

marginfi-lending.note: Points are live: MRGN points carried 1:1 into Project 0 at its September 2025 relaunch, and Project 0's January 2026 roadmap post names a token launch after it integrates the majority of Solana lending TVL.
marginfi-lending.source: Project 0 launch post (Sep 2025) and roadmap (Jan 2026), via Solana Compass

loopscale-lending.note: Loopscale Points are live for lending, borrowing, looping and referrals, per the protocol's own docs FAQ. After the October 2026 merger with Orca into Formation, the points are slated to convert later in 2026.
loopscale-lending.source: Loopscale docs FAQ; AirdropTracker research brief, Nov 2026
